author: blu
body: Generates vm-config.ps1 -- shared VM config + helpers for the harness. Memory-mapped I/O: no serial ports, no TCP sockets. The VM loads input from a file into guest memory at 0x400000. Output is written by the guest to 0x500000 and dumped to a file on exit. Compile with: -Decks 300. The chapter is one long list of string literals and outgrows the default LOWER floor; the knob is documented in the Operator's Manual. It previously said -Survey "lower-mul:500000", which named a system deleted on 2026-07-07 -- the need was real, the flag was gone.

author: blu
body: This generator emits vm-config.ps1, and vm-config.ps1 is NOT generated from it today: 85 scripts dot-source the .ps1 and nothing runs this chapter, so the .ps1 is hand-maintained and the two are one edit apart from disagreeing. Sections S03 to S05 were re-synced on 2026-07-16 and are byte-identical to the live file. Everything else still differs cosmetically (this emits a param block and a "do not edit by hand" banner the live file lacks, and formats loops differently), so regenerating over the .ps1 is a real change and not a no-op.

author: blu
body: A CDX carries its own symbol map -- a MAP1 block the emitter writes into the data segment -- and that is what these functions read. The text sidecar is a fallback and an explicit override, never the default, because it drifts: the seed is built -Repl, -Repl emits no text MAP: block, so neither a seed rebuild nor a copy-up ever refreshes seed/Codex.map. An embedded map cannot drift from the binary it describes. The two traps are that entry code-offsets are relative to the 1 MB load address and that the names are CCE rather than ASCII.
